comment: Haukke Manor's last boss's 14505 (level 28, 714 HP): a gaze (28648) every 34.2 s, nothing else. Bob's Chronofoil captures of Haukke Manor (territory 1040) on 2026-11-02: 5d9c7d7f visit 0.2 (48 minutes with Duty Support, during quest 801) and e7580e0d visits 0.1, 0.3 and 0.5 (Duty Finder runs with three other players), `questkit chronofoil --battle`. `players` is the median damage to players over the four runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
